note: _unusquisque in suo sensu abundet_. How to render _sensus_ and _abundare_? Literal renderings: let every man abound in his own sense (Doay Version); que chacun abonde dans son sense (Glaire). Other, more interpretative renderings: let either rest fully content in his opinion (Knox); ein jeder sei nur von seiner eigenen Meinung überzeugt (Allioli); jeder genüge seiner Überzeugung (Grundl).
_qui autem discernit_ (Vg, NVg) – but he who discerns (Douay Version). According to Richards (p. 37), _discernere_ is the wrong word, because _diakrinesthai_ means “to hesitate.”
